description: The Center for Medical Cannabis and Psilocybin hosted the sixth Equity, Access and Cultural Considerations Committee meeting for the Medical Psilocybin Advisory Board. The Chair, DezBaa, facilitated discussion of qualifications and process for determining patient eligibility for the Patient Equity Fund.
